statement.excerpt: Have a significant technological breakthrough such that it reduces the costs of building and operating GPT — or whatever model that succeeds it — by a factor of thousands of percent.

from_speaker: for OpenAI to survive for longer than two years
reduces the costs of building and operating GPT — or whatever model that succeeds it
by a factor of thousands of percent
our_interpretation: This is a necessary-condition hypothesis. If OpenAI survives more than two years, the claim implies a significant breakthrough cut the costs of building and operating its models by 'thousands of percent'. The only plain sense of that phrase is a cut of tens of times or more.

The speaker did not say which costs: total spending on building and running the models, or cost per unit of output (per token, or at a fixed level of capability). The two readings point in opposite directions, so no single reading is imposed here.
No deadline is set for the breakthrough. Survival past 2026-07-29 is the condition only.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI survived past 2026-07-29, and evidence shows a significant breakthrough that cut its costs of building and operating models by tens of times or more, on a cost basis the speaker plainly meant.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI survived past 2026-07-29 with no such cut in its costs of building and operating models on any fair reading.
